protocol.design: legacy bridge plus 2x2 independent/coupled braking x fixed/curvature speed cap
protocol.forecast: same 0.1s commands as execution; union of immediate and 0.2s delayed stops; <=1cm corner-travel samples
protocol.terminal: latch goal/no_path/stall/timeout and execute deceleration to exact rest; collision abort retains incoming speed and no fictitious rest
protocol.arrival: true distance <0.25m and v<0.05m/s eligibility retained; complete only after full stop still within same circle
protocol.score_access: truth and actual geometry only sensing and offline scoring; controller receives estimate, prior, observations
